interpretation.restore_commit: Omitted means the complete exact default_restore_commit, not latest main
interpretation.sha256_source: whole-small-file-read means full text below100000B was read and hashed here; otherwise it is the exact preserved small original evidence path, not a new hash of a raw candidate
interpretation.null_sha256: Unknown in examined small evidence; Git blob+size+fixedcommit still identify exact full bytes
interpretation.candidate_set: Only the16 full repository paths in the companion retention ledger may be deleted; every other record remains unchanged or recoverable from its stated preexisting archive
interpretation.metadata_scope: Only Git tree metadata was used for large/binary objects. All binary and all sixteen raw candidate bodies were unread.
